note: Halloween takes over Oahu — free spooktaculars and a keiki costume contest.

picks.reason: Halloween Spooktacular at Hawaii Kai Towne Center — free trick-or-treating and entertainment.
Halloween Keiki Costume Contest at Royal Hawaiian Center — free to enter and watch.
James the Magnificent Halloween Magic Show at Kaimukī Library — free magic for kids.
Read to a Therapy Dog at Kaimukī Library — free, calm and great for early readers.
